description: FALLBACK. The primary path is emet_session_open then emet_transcript_append after every reply; use this only where a host cannot append per reply. Saves the full word-for-word dialog of a session - full transcripts only, no summaries. Pass exchanges in the call. The server does not read a file. Refused for a session that was closed complete.

channel.description: Alias of `source` (the older name, kept one release). Prefer `source`.

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

exchanges.description: Claude.ai Project mode: full array of exchange objects for this session

timestamp.description: Optional Unix timestamp for this exchange

session_end.description: Unix timestamp — session end (optional, defaults to now)

source.description: Source tag - which host produced this write. One name on every write since 2026-09-27.

name: save_transcript
